stories.title: It Runs in the Family
stories.detail: The O'Connells have taken over the leaderboard, with Richard and Max both posting a tidy number.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga Country Club, Damien Widdison - great to have Wauchope GC with us today. Enjoy your round.

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 4 & 5 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 pars on holes 10, 11 & 12 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 pars on the bounce on holes 10, 11 & 12

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: nett birdie to bogey on holes 1 & 2 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 pars in a row on holes 11-14 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Triple Trouble
stories.detail: Triple bogey on hole 3 - that one is going to take some forgetting

stories.title: Bogey Parade
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 3, 4 & 5 - sticking to the bogey script

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back blow-ups on holes 4 & 5 - we'll move on
